description: This file defines the 'IntegrationConfiguration' class, which models the configuration settings for integrating with external gateways within the system. It includes properties for environment, module code, activation status, and related keys and options, as well as JSON serialization methods.

classes.name: IntegrationConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the configuration for an external gateway integration, supporting JSON serialization with custom string formatting and nested data structures for keys and options.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JSON string, including nested 'integrationKeys' and 'integrationOptions'.

methods.name: getJsonInfo
methods.description: Generates a JSON fragment string with primary properties for internal use.

methods.name: setModuleCode
methods.description: Sets the module code identifying the integration.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets whether the integration is active.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether the integration is active.

methods.name: setIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Assigns the map of integration keys.

methods.name: getIntegrationKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the map of integration keys.

methods.name: setEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the environment type (TEST or PRODUCTION).

methods.name: setDefaultSelected
methods.description: Marks whether this configuration is the default selection.

methods.name: isDefaultSelected
methods.description: Checks if this configuration is marked as default.

methods.name: setIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Defines options related to the integration.

methods.name: getIntegrationOptions
methods.description: Returns the options map for the integration.
